results.title: Qdrant - Vector Database
results.summary: Qdrant is an open-source vector database and similarity search engine written in Rust, offered self-hosted or as a managed cloud service.

results.title: Weaviate: The AI-native database developers love
results.summary: Weaviate is an open-source vector database that stores objects and vectors together and supports hybrid keyword and vector search.

results.title: Milvus | High-Performance Vector Database Built for Scale
results.summary: Milvus is an open-source vector database built for scalable similarity search over billions of vectors, maintained under the LF AI & Data Foundation. It offers distributed deployment, GPU indexing, and many index types, and has a managed service called Zilliz Cloud. This sentence is here so the summary runs past the tool's cap and the test can see it cut.
